summary.name: Launch OS
summary.one_liner: Launch OS is a $197/month business workspace that combines customers, tasks, follow-ups, and reports with an AI assistant called Atlas that reads the workspace records.
keywords: one place for customers and tasks
use_cases: Track customer follow-ups and promised callbacks
Manage quotes, jobs, and renewals by industry
See overdue and due-this-week tasks for a team
Ask an AI assistant which customers need attention today
Keep customer notes and history in one workspace
summary.what_it_does: Launch OS holds customers, tasks, notes, and sales work (quotes, jobs, stages) in one workspace for a team. Each item can get an owner, due date, and priority, and the work board flags overdue, stalled, or due-soon items. Atlas, its built-in assistant, answers plain-language questions about the records and shows which records it used, and can suggest actions that the user must approve. It connects to the user's own AI account (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok), can link GoHighLevel contacts and opportunities, and accepts data from forms or automation tools through a private link. Industry workspaces (32 listed) provide starting stages, tasks, and checklists, and four visual themes are offered.
notable: Atlas assistant shows the workspace records behind each answer and only acts after the user presses Do it
32 industry starting points with tailored stages and tasks
Flat $197/month for unlimited team members with no per-user fees
Bring-your-own AI key (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok); AI usage billed separately by the provider
caveats: $197 per month subscription; AI provider API usage billed separately
Industry workspaces are starting points, not specialist booking, policy management, or industry payment systems
Atlas cannot send messages, charge customers, or publish on its own
